parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made of glass, typically rectangular and flat.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output such as images, videos, and text. It is the main interface for viewing content.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed in position and does not move relative to the base.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base part of the display, made of aluminum, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen and maintains its upright position on a surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary and provides stability; it does not move during normal operation.
